items.name: Callawassie Island
items.note: Gated residential island community, 880 acres, 717 home sites, 27-hole Fazio course; Wikipedia infobox address is 176 Callawassie Drive, Okatie, SC 29909; in Beaufort County; reached by half-mile causeway south of SC 170. Public site callawassieisland.com titled 'Private Gated Community' with Okatie SC 29909 map links.

items.name: Oldfield
items.note: Builder page: 'an exclusive, gated community in the charming coastal town of Okatie, South Carolina', sales office 130 Oldfield Way, Okatie, SC 29909. Already on Wikipedia Okatie page. (Builder marketing page, not official.)

items.name: Sun City Hilton Head (already in grid)
items.note: Wikipedia: age-restricted planned community in the Okatie area, Beaufort and Jasper counties; Del Webb; three phases around golf courses and community centers; individual neighbourhoods not named.

items.name: Riverbend (already in grid)
items.note: On the Wikipedia Okatie page; also a county planning minute (2003) mentions 'River's End and River's Bend subdivisions' on Highway 170.

items.name: River's End (weak)
items.note: Named in 2003 Beaufort County Planning Commission minutes as a subdivision on Highway 170 near Okatie; no current source that it is described as Okatie; Okatie Marsh PUD (2008) is 'directly south of the River's End Subdivision'.
items.source: https://www.beaufortcountysc.gov/planning-commission/minutes/2003/120203.pdf ; https://www.beaufortcountysc.gov/council/council-action-summaries/2008/2008-september.pdf (via search summary; not read in full)

items.name: Spring Island (weak - Okatie only as mailing address)
items.note: Spring Island Trust office and Spring Island Realty list Okatie, SC 29909 addresses (40 / 38 Mobley Oaks Ln); the Spring Island site itself says the island community is 'in Beaufort, SC' and calls it a 'Private Waterfront Community'; gating and ARB not stated on pages read. Trust says it works with the Spring Island POA.

not_found_tried: Berkeley Hall, Heyward Pointe, Rose Dhu Creek, Colleton River Plantation: only real-estate listing sites describe them (Berkeley Hall 'in Bluffton' on an agent site; Heyward Pointe/Okatie unconfirmed); berkeleyhall.com is a parked domain; no official or Wikipedia source placing them in Okatie. Not added.
Belfair, Rose Hill Plantation: Bluffton, not Okatie per sources seen.

Result: 4 solid (Callawassie Island, Oldfield, Sun City Hilton Head, Riverbend) + 2 weak (River's End, Spring Island) = fewer than 6 solid. Wikipedia page for Spring Island returned 404; no Okatie-neighbourhood list on Beaufort County or Jasper County pages found.

items.name: Callawassie Sugar Works
items.note: NRHP-listed 27 May 2014 (ref 13001096); 'the only sugar mill ruins known to exist in South Carolina' (Wikipedia, Callawassie Island article); 29 Sugar Mill Dr., Okatie; tabby ruins on gated Callawassie Island - public access not stated.

items.name: Altamaha Town Heritage Preserve
items.note: County page: 100-acre oak-hickory forest on the Okatie and Colleton Rivers, listed on the NRHP in 1994, Yamasee village and colonial cemetery site; Old Bailey's Road off Okatie Highway (SC 170), 'Okatie, SC'; dawn to dusk; 0.5-mile flat trail. Wikipedia lists nearest city as Bluffton (NRHP 21 Jan 1994, ref 93001479).

items.name: Old Barrel Landing School
items.note: One-room schoolhouse on SC Hwy 170, Okatie 29909; served grades 1-8 until 1919; restored 1995; named for a landing on the Okatie River. NRHP status not stated.

not_found_tried: Wikipedia Okatie page states no NRHP sites; NRHP Beaufort County list shows Callawassie Sugar Works as the only Okatie-located entry I could read (second half of the list page was not readable via fetch).

items.name: Altamaha Town Heritage Preserve (county passive park)
items.note: See above; open dawn to dusk, leashed dogs.

items.name: Widgeon Point Preserve (county passive park)
items.note: 43 Okatie Hwy (county lists as Beaufort, SC); 0.7-mile earthen loop; hours 6am-7pm winter, 7am-8pm daylight time; leashed dogs. Not stated as in Okatie.
items.source: https://www.beaufortcountysc.gov/events/2024/09/09.28.2024 Birding at Widgeon Point Perserve.html (via search summary)

items.name: Camp St. Mary's Park (county)
items.note: 121 Camp St. Mary's Road, 'Okatie area of Beaufort County', about 10 acres on the Okatie River; open for pier and dock access only (2023 notice); gate 7am-7pm.

faq_sources.topic: Do you work in Spring Island, Callawassie Island and other Okatie communities? (public facts only)
answer_facts: Callawassie Island: gated residential community (Wikipedia: developed 'as a gated, residential community' after 1981); 880 acres; 717 home sites; Okatie, SC 29909 address; Beaufort County; half-mile causeway south of SC 170 or by boat; site title 'Private Gated Community'.

Spring Island: 'Private Waterfront Community' (springisland.com); Okatie SC 29909 mailing address for Spring Island Trust and Spring Island Realty; site says it is 'in Beaufort, SC'; Trust works with the Spring Island POA; gating and architectural review not stated on pages read. Not described by a public source as 'in Okatie' beyond mailing addresses.
Oldfield: builder page says gated community in Okatie.

Not found: any published architectural review/roof guidelines for Callawassie Island, Spring Island or Oldfield (searched; Callawassie site has a 'Building on Callawassie' link with no content retrieved).

faq_candidates.question: Is the Callawassie Sugar Works or any historic site near my Okatie home going to limit what roof I can put on?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Okatie has NRHP properties (Callawassie Sugar Works, Altamaha Town) - but I found nothing tying them to roofing rules; likely NOT answerable from a source. Low confidence.
answer_facts: NRHP listing does not by itself restrict private neighbouring homes (not sourced from a page I read) - do not use unless Paul wants it sourced further.

faq_candidates.question: How does a roofer get into a gated Okatie community like Callawassie Island or Oldfield?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Callawassie Island and Oldfield are gated Okatie communities; Callawassie is reached only by a half-mile causeway or boat.
answer_facts: Public facts only: Callawassie Island is gated (Wikipedia; callawassieisland.com), reached by half-mile causeway south of SC 170; Oldfield described as gated (builder page). The gate procedure itself is NOT published on pages I read (client/community fact).

faq_candidates.question: Is my Okatie home in a flood zone, and where do I get an elevation certificate?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Okatie sits on the Okatee River estuary, unincorporated Beaufort/Jasper County; the county flood page applies. Weak on portability (true of any unincorporated Beaufort County area).
answer_facts: Beaufort County building codes flood page: links a flood zone verification form and quick facts, a way to request Elevation Certificates for your property (Building Inspections contact 843-255-2086), and the Beaufort County Flood Damage Prevention Ordinance. Page does not state roof or substantial-improvement rules. Jasper-County side of Okatie: not researched.

flags: Okatie neighbourhoods: only 4 solid + 2 weak found; need 6-12. Paul decides: ship 4-6 with weak items, or keep grid short.
Sun City Hilton Head ARC roof/exterior rules: not found (site suncityhiltonhead.org is an HOA portal; no guidelines visible). No Sun City FAQ candidate possible.
Callawassie Sugar Works sits inside a gated community; public access not stated, so cite as a site only, not a visitable attraction.
Okatie population figures on Wikipedia are inconsistent (already noted in facts).
